history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me get it working again?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service and picture messaging issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll guide you through the steps to restore your service.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Thank you, Sofia. I have your account details. To help restore your service and picture messaging, I’ll guide you through a few quick checks and actions on your phone.

First, can you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- If Airplane Mode is on
- What the signal bars show (if any)
- If you see any network type (like 5G, 4G, LTE, etc.)

If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I’ll guide you through it.
My status bar shows Airplane Mode, No Signal, Data Enabled, and battery at 87%. There are no signal bars and it looks like Airplane Mode is on.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which will block all cellular service and prevent you from sending messages or using mobile data.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your device. Once you’ve done that, check if your signal bars reappear and if you can use your service again. Let me know what you see after turning Airplane Mode off.
Airplane mode is now off, but there are still no signal bars and I still can't use any service.

Your line was suspended, which is why you had no service. I have now resumed your line and it is active again.

Please reboot your phone to restore service. After restarting, check if your signal bars appear and if you can use your phone and send picture messages. Let me know if everything is working or if you still have issues.

response.result: Line LN-8830142 has been resumed and is now Active.

history.content: My phone rebooted successfully, but I still have no signal bars and can't use any service.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no service, the next step is to check your SIM card status. Please check your phone’s SIM card status and let me know if it shows as active, missing, or locked. If you need instructions on how to check this, let me know.
My SIM card status shows as active, but I still have no signal bars and can't use any service.

Thank you for checking your SIM card status. Since your SIM is active and your line is no longer suspended, the next step is to check your phone’s network settings, specifically the APN (Access Point Name) settings, which are required for service and messaging.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything appears incorrect or if the MMSC URL is missing. If you’re unsure how to check, let me know and I’ll guide you through it.
I checked my APN settings: the APN name is fast.telecom.net, but it says 'Not set' and the MMSC URL is listed as http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc. What should I do next?

Thank you for providing your APN details. Since your APN name is listed as "Not set," this could be causing your service and messaging issues.

Please reset your APN settings to the default values on your phone. After resetting, you’ll need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Let me know once you’ve reset the APN settings and restarted your phone, and if your service returns. If you need instructions on how to reset APN settings, let me know.
I've already reset the APN settings to defaults and rebooted my phone. The APN is now 'internet' and the MMSC URL is 'http://mms.carrier.com/mms'. I still have no signal bars and no service.

Thank you for updating your APN settings and rebooting your phone. Since your SIM is active, your line is active, and your APN settings are now set to defaults, but you still have no signal bars or service, this may indicate a more complex technical issue that cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.

I will transfer you to a human agent who can further investigate and resolve your issue.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
